capabilities: Run Obsidian searches from wrapped code blocks and insert results below them
Format search results as lists or tables with a default template
Customize output with the eta template engine or legacy sequence templates
Access file metadata (frontmatter, headings, links, sections) in templates
disambiguation: Not a text-snippet expander; it expands wrapped search queries into lists of found files.
extras: The sequence template engine is marked LEGACY, with eta as the newer option.
intentEvidence: This plugin will search files using Obsidian search functionality and then paste the result.
problem: Obsidian's search panel shows results but offers no way to insert them into a note as links or tables.
summary: Search-based expander that runs Obsidian searches from code blocks and pastes matching files into the note using templates.
